description: For sellers, free: send an x402 (or MPP) endpoint an unpaid request and check its 402 against the spec (v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, v1 body, CAIP-2 network ids, amount, payTo format, EIP-712 domain for USDC, Solana feePayer, bazaar extension, offer-receipt signed offers against your did:web, CORS), the catalogue listing, OFAC and issuer freezes, and /openapi.json x-payment-info. When the 402's x402 terms are read, the lint also sends the CORS preflight a browser sends before paying, up to one per x402 version they come in; none for MPP or for any other answer. When a request gets no answer and alalanet's own network is confirmed, the lint runs once more over new connections: a second unpaid request and its preflights. One lint per host every 10 s. Returns pass / warn / fail / info checks with fixes and a verdict. Also a GitHub Action: x402 lint by alalanet.

method.description: HTTP method buyers use: GET (default) or POST, as your listing declares; POST sends an empty JSON body

url.description: https URL of your paid x402 (or MPP) endpoint exactly as buyers call it, with any query it needs (path and query included, e.g. .../v1/forecast?city=Lisbon)

name: lint_x402_endpoint
title: Lint your own x402 endpoint
